messages:
Jade: Quick pass to CS — Elara (health-analytics startup) signed yesterday. They're on a yearly contract, $18k MRR, asked for Private deployment (VPC) and SSO. Renewal window: Oct 2026 (flagged). 

Priya: Thanks @Jade — I'm taking CSM. Can you confirm expected go-live timeframe and any pilot KPIs? Also who from their side will own infra? :memo:

Jade: Go-live target = 6 weeks. Pilot KPI = <50ms P95 for chat generate on 512 tokens, and embedding throughput 250 reqs/min. Elara IR lead is "Maya Torres" (m.torres@elara.ai). They want dedicated pool but ok with initial hosted p3s to validate. 

Priya: Noted. I'll schedule kickoff with Maya. Two immediate risks: (1) SSO (SAML) and (2) PHI handling — legal asked for data segregation checklist. Marking renewal as medium risk until baseline metrics are met. :warning:

Ravi: I'll own infra provisioning and SSO config. Need VPC CIDR + allowed egress IPs from Elara and confirmation on KMS usage. Sample request I'll send to their infra: 
```
- VPC CIDR: x.x.x.x/16
- Peering window: preferred DST window Mon-Fri 02:00-06:00 UTC
- KMS: customer-managed (yes/no)
```

Priya: Adding enablement asks: product walkthrough for Maya's ML infra team, and a short runbook for on-call flows. Can @Marco on Support Eng join kickoff? Marco will handle alerting thresholds and runbook review. :raised_hands:

Marco: On it. I'll pre-seed an ops-runbook and error thresholds. Also need sample logs from their test harness to run through our parser. Suggest we create a single shared ticket and attach artifacts — use CS ticketing prefix ELARA-ops-1.

Jade: FYI sales committed a 2-week pilot with a usage cap. If we hit >75% of cap, they want a predictability conversation — possible upgrade to Dedicated. Keep an eye on billing alerts. 

Priya: Action items so far: 
- Priya: schedule kickoff w/ Maya + Elara infra (by EOD Thu) :calendar: 
- Ravi: send VPC + KMS template to Maya (by EOD Fri) :email: 
- Marco: draft ops runbook and create ELARA-ops-1 (today) :gear: 
- Jade: share pilot acceptance criteria doc and contract excerpt (done) :white_check_mark:

Ravi: Quick technical note — for initial validation we'll spin up a 1-node ded. pool (q4A quantized model) with prefix caching off to measure cold-starts. Config preview: 
```
cluster: dedicated-small
GPUs: 1xA10G
quant: int8
cache: disabled
SLO-target: p95 < 80ms
```

Marco: Re alerts, recommend thresholds: error rate > 1% over 5m, tail lat > 500ms p99. I'll place those into the runbook and wire to oncall-bot. Also will add escalation path to Eng (Ravi) then to CS (Priya).

Priya: I'll create the customer success plan doc and invite owners. Also want to capture feedback during pilot — short weekly survey (3 qs) after each milestone. Jade — can you nudge Maya to join a 30-min enablement session in week 1?

Jade: Yep, told Maya and she prefers Tue mornings. I put tentative calendar hold for 2025-07-08 10:00 PT. 

oncall-bot: Created ticket ELARA-ops-1 assigned to Marco. Pinged #oncall for monitoring setup.

Priya: Final note — renewal ops: flag account for early engagement in Q3 2026 if pilot metrics lag. If we hit pilot KPIs ahead of schedule, ops will recommend early upsell conversation for Dedicated commit. I'll mark that in Salesforce and ops tracker.

Marco: I'll post the first draft runbook in the ticket and drop a link here when ready. Expect ~3hrs to draft.

Ravi: Once we have VPC details I can request peering and start infra prep. If Elara requires HSM/KMS integration, account exec to confirm budget for HSM.

Priya: Great — thanks team. I'm logging these as owners in the CS workspace and will follow up after kickoff. :rocket:
